morningSummary.title: MORNING SUMMARY
morningSummary.description: Energy, security and economic uncertainty dominate today's global picture. The biggest immediate development is the continuing discussion between Iran and Oman over possible arrangements for shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. Oil prices have moved lower on hopes of improved traffic, although the waterway remains heavily disrupted. Nigeria continues to deal with a serious kidnapping crisis, while new research highlights the financial scale of ransom payments. The disruption at Russia's NORSI refinery adds another pressure point to regional fuel supplies, while artificial intelligence remains one of the world's biggest technology investment stories.

bigQuestion: Can diplomacy succeed in easing the energy crisis, or will geopolitical tensions continue to keep global fuel prices under pressure?
